title: 1 Timothy 6:10 and 'the gold of that land is good' — yeshua is Better than Gold
summary: 1 Timothy 6:10 (the love of money is the root of all evil; some coveted and erred from the faith) with 'love' in red, 'money' in green and 'all evil' enlarged. Below, the line 'The gold of that land is good' (the verse 12 line from the Eden story, gold highlighted, check mark on 'good') leads to the conclusion 'yeshua ✔ Better than Gold!'.
